summary: An early-access Arc successor for Apple silicon Macs and iPhone/iPad. Rebuilds Spaces, sidebar, Peek, Split View and Quick Window; uses ungoogled-chromium on Mac, WebKit per site or on iOS; imports from Arc, Zen, Chrome, Safari, Firefox.
bestFor: Arc users who want an open-source replacement

pros.title: Arc-style workflow
pros.detail: Spaces, sidebar, Peek, Split View, Quick Window.

pros.title: iCloud sync
pros.detail: Syncs through iCloud across Mac and iOS.

pros.title: Arc import
pros.detail: Imports from Arc and other browsers.

cons.title: Early access
cons.detail: Less polished than Arc by user reports.

cons.title: Unaudited
cons.detail: Project says security not independently audited.

faq.a: It is early access and unaudited.
ungoogled-chromium on Mac, WebKit per site or on iOS.
It targets Arc users but lacks Boosts and Windows support.

timeline.event: Arc sunset announced, driving interest in Crest

switching.note: Imports from Arc, Zen, Chrome, Safari and Firefox.
